title: Normative TDMA specs define incompatible SFN slot-hash formulas
description: Final Python/spec correctness review: spec/09-packets-timing.md §14.7 and python/src/lichen/timing/sfn.py/test/vectors/ccp_sfn_wrap_slot_hash.json define slot=(FNV1a32(EUI64)+u32(SFN)) mod N. spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md §2a.2 instead declares FNV1a32(EUI64 XOR SFN) mod N as the one true interop algorithm, while spec/02a-tdma.md declares FNV1a32(EUI64 || SFN little-endian) mod N. These produce different slots and the §14.7 cross-reference claims 02a is authoritative, so conforming implementations can never interoperate. Choose one canonical preimage/formula, update every normative spec/example/vector description and executable Python/Rust consumer, and add cross-document fixed vectors at SFN 0, 1, 0xffffffff, and wrap.
acceptance_criteria: One unambiguous formula and byte order is normative everywhere; Python and Rust execute the same independent vectors including wrap.
